climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Chardonnay sits in its sweet spot, so the wines can show the style it is known for.
land: Faces the midday sun. In a climate this cool, that extra warmth is often what gets grapes fully ripe.

blurb.text: A Burgundy appellation within Chablis, making white wine from Chardonnay alone. It is limited to the commune of Chablis. Chablis is Burgundy's northernmost appellation, and its cool climate gives wines more acidity and less fruitiness, often with a flinty note.
